kit-element-marks.placement: K1 particles: 5 residue marks in one row (32x32 cells: leaf, flame, stone, needle, ripple), sliced; pulses in code
kit-element-marks.description: A row of five small separate pixel art marks on a transparent background, evenly spaced, each about 24 pixels: 1) a single curled green leaf, 2) a small vermilion fox-fire flame with a curled tail, 3) a square ochre stone chip, 4) two crossed thin silver needles, 5) a small indigo water ring ripple seen from above. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Japanese Heian onmyodo and shrine maiden folk magic style: washi paper talismans with fictional brush strokes, folded paper, black and vermilion lacquer, eerie dignified yokai. NOT Thai, NOT Chinese, NOT Indonesian, NOT Slavic, NOT anime: no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no glowing crystals, no lightning, no torii gate, no pentagram or star shape, no taiji, no swastika or manji, no rising sun rays, no runes, no readable kanji or text, no religious symbols, no character, no person, no blood, no gore, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are warm washi off-white, never pure white.
